label: About
title: About Mist Impact Scaffold
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1209 recent saved-signal files and 317 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Canek Zapata — roy vs jigglypuff with pokeballs and YouTube Playlists, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Mist Impact Scaffold: Vertical game-space surface, source-led balanced plate: a low-poly log-and-rope scaffold dominates the left and bottom over a mist ravine, with open pale cyan sky upper right. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against pink bead collision mass at the combat hinge, lower log scaffold ridge and plank seams, and distant cliff bridge aperture.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
